decision.reason: Rotating/reversing four-letter OVERDOSE center streams can create tempting short words such as DOVE, ROSE, SORE, and EROS, but no checked source witness supplies the required start-point, rotation, or direction rule.
decision.nextMove: Treat DOVE/ROSE/SORE/EROS center-rotation hits as arbitrary short-word artifacts. Reopen only if a distinct source supplies a start/rotation instruction that also survives p75 and mirror/reverse controls.
